dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.answer: Aggregated multi-site neurodevelopmental datasets plus BrainChart reference sample
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Study data: ABIDE, POND, HBN, ADHD200, Female ASD (NDAR), UCSD Biomarkers of Autism, UK MRC-AIMS (49 sites); Reference: BrainChart life-span sample of 75,241 typically developing individuals for normative models
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "T1-weighted scans were combined from 49 sites across 7 datasets, including the ABIDE... the POND... the HBN... the ADHD200... the ... Female ASD dataset..., the UK MRC-AIMS..., and the ... UCSD... study"; "reference models using ... a sample of 75,241 TD individuals"
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Sample and Datasets / Data Processing

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.answer: BrainChart TD sample used to train normative centile models; aggregated clinical/TD datasets used for out-of-sample centile scoring and group comparisons
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: BrainChart TD reference provided trained GAMLSS models; ComBat-harmonized study datasets (TD, autism, ADHD) were scored out-of-sample to derive centiles and examine diagnostic, sex, and age effects
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Our previous work... generated reference models using... 75,241 TD individuals... Out-of-sample centile scores for our study sample were generated based on these reference models"
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Generation of Centile Scores Using Generalized Additive Models of Location Scale and Shape
